A mining blast occurs at the surface of a deep lake. An observer at a distance detects the sound of the explosion through the air and through the water. The sound pulse traveling through the air is received after the sound pulse traveling through the water. The speed of sound in air is and the speed of sound in the water is . What is the distance from the observer to the site of the blast?

  1. 2.0 km
  2. 2.4 km
  3. 3.0 km
  4. 12.0 km
